name: All Sphere Dimensions in Union-Closed Coefficient Spaces
statement: For every $m\ge2$ there is a union-closed realizable finite convex-treelike class $U_m$ with $30m+8$ concepts, VC dimension four, and $\mathcal A(U_m)\cong S^{m-2}\times\mathbb R^{d_m-m+2}$. Both $\eta_0(U_m)$ and $\eta_\infty(U_m)$ equal one. In particular $U_2$ has two Euclidean components and $U_3$ has a circle factor.
proof: Use the arbitrary-digraph construction on a directed cycle. Its arrangement complement is the complement of the full diagonal, hence $S^{m-2}\times\mathbb R^2$. Union closure makes both side indicators finite, while either zero would force a Euclidean coefficient space and contradict the sphere factor.
